parameters.content:
## Supabase job polling
Runs every minute and processes the oldest eligible queued parse_document job through the fenced claim/publish boundary (capacity and backoff enforced by the claim RPC).

Required env: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, XASS_DOCUMENT_WORKER_URL, XASS_WORKER_SECRET.

Claim: rpc/claim_next_available_document_job mints an attempt claim token. Publish: rpc/complete_document_job verifies the token and an unexpired lease inside one atomic transaction. Failure: rpc/fail_document_job_attempt is equally fenced. A stale or expired attempt can neither extend the lease, overwrite results, nor publish twice.

Worker response contract

The worker downloads the document itself from canonical Storage state, parses it, runs grouped extraction/AI, persists checkpoint tables (document_chunks, document_extraction_groups, cost_observations), and returns JSON: facts[], summary, summary_sources[], health_snapshots[], alerts[], actions[], anomalies[], processing_status.

The worker only computes checkpoints; final results are published once by rpc/complete_document_job, which validates the claim token and lease inside the publication transaction. If the worker reports failure or loses its claim, rpc/fail_document_job_attempt records it under the same ownership rule.

Required n8n environment variables

SUPABASE_URL
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
XASS_DOCUMENT_WORKER_URL
XASS_WORKER_SECRET

Never expose the service-role key in the Next.js app.

Cutover: import this workflow while it is inactive, apply migration 202611020002, then activate this workflow and deactivate the legacy webhook workflow. Old executions calling the dropped unfenced claim RPCs fail loudly instead of bypassing fencing.
